> Senior Software Engineer and Mobile Architect. Eight years building React
> Native products for fintech, banking, media, healthcare and commerce, plus the

## Current role
The Coca-Cola Company, USA — Senior Full Stack Software Engineer (Apr 2025 to present).
Backend-for-frontend architecture on Node.js and AWS for the marketplace
platform, Python Lambda functions and Dockerised services. Offline-first React
Native platform using WatermelonDB for local persistence and conflict
resolution. Native iOS (Swift) and Android (Kotlin/Java) modules for biometrics,
encrypted storage and hardware integrations. Configures and operates a
multi-agent AI system built on LangGraph and the Claude Agent SDK that works
front-end and back-end tickets, reviewing and validating every change as the
accountable engineer. Automated pull-request creation across multi-environment,
multi-account AWS microservices.

## Earlier roles
- NFL+ CTV, USA — Senior Software Engineer (Feb 2024 to Mar 2025). React Native
  and TheoPlayer video player across mobile, web and smart TVs for millions of
  viewers. Recoil to Jotai migration, Expo-compatible native modules in a
  Turborepo monorepo, Datadog profiling.
- Itaú Bank, ITU App, Chile — Software Engineer (Dec 2021 to Feb 2024). Biometric
  authentication and encrypted transaction workflows for 100,000+ users. 90%+
  automated test coverage with Jest, Detox and Appium. Bitrise and Jenkins CI/CD.
- Platanitos Apps, Peru — Full Stack Software Engineer (Mar 2019 to Dec 2021).
  Migration to React Native and Expo across iOS, Android and Huawei; the commerce
  app passed 1 million downloads. Mercado Pago, Algolia, Firebase, Firestore.
- Gruppo GPI, NGH Healthcare, Italy and Germany — Software Engineer (Mar 2018 to
  Mar 2019). Medical reporting and annotation systems across 3,000+ hospitals and
  clinics in Europe.

## Skills
Mobile: React Native, Expo (managed and bare), TypeScript, Swift, Kotlin/Java,
native modules, React Native New Architecture (JSI, TurboModules, Fabric),
WatermelonDB, offline-first architecture.
AI: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, multi-agent
orchestration, spec-driven development, on-device AI with TensorFlow Lite.
Cloud and backend: AWS (multi-account, Lambda in Python), Google Cloud and
Firestore, Node.js, Firebase, GraphQL, REST, WebSockets, SQL.
CI/CD: GitHub Actions, EAS, Bitrise, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes, Turborepo, OTA
updates.
Testing and observability: Jest, Appium, Detox, Datadog, New Relic.
Security: Keychain and Keystore, biometrics, SSL pinning.
